Run **Memory publish** and nothing else.

Follow [MP-memory-publish.md](../../playbook/MP-memory-publish.md), [memory-release.md](../../playbook/memory-release.md).

Confirm the version and contents with me before copying anything.

Report in chat what was published and how to share it, then stop.
